results.shadow_sql: SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE (SELECT (`p`.`close_prefix` - COALESCE(`p_prev`.`close_prefix`, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(`p`.`close_count_prefix` - COALESCE(`p_prev`.`close_count_prefix`, 0), 0) / 10000.0 FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic_prefix` AS p LEFT JOIN `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic_prefix` AS p_prev ON `p_prev`.`mktcode` = `p`.`mktcode` AND `p_prev`.`tgtcode` = `p`.`tgtcode` AND `p_prev`.`row_no` = `p`.`row_no` - 5 WHERE `p`.`mktcode` = `q`.`mktcode` AND `p`.`tgtcode` = `q`.`tgtcode` AND `p`.`bizdate` = `q`.`bizdate`) > 10

SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE (SELECT (`p`.`volume_prefix` - COALESCE(`p_prev`.`volume_prefix`, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(`p`.`volume_count_prefix` - COALESCE(`p_prev`.`volume_count_prefix`, 0), 0) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic_prefix` AS p LEFT JOIN `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic_prefix` AS p_prev ON `p_prev`.`mktcode` = `p`.`mktcode` AND `p_prev`.`tgtcode` = `p`.`tgtcode` AND `p_prev`.`row_no` = `p`.`row_no` - 5 WHERE `p`.`mktcode` = `q`.`mktcode` AND `p`.`tgtcode` = `q`.`tgtcode` AND `p`.`bizdate` = `q`.`bizdate`) > 1000
